mapper.sql: outbox_id AS outboxId, report_id AS reportId, event_id AS eventId, schema_version AS schemaVersion, status, attempt_count AS attemptCount, last_error_code AS lastErrorCode, payload_json AS payloadJson, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_archive_outbox (outbox_id, report_id, event_id, schema_version, status, attempt_count, payload_json, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{outboxId}, #{reportId}, #{eventId}, #{schemaVersion}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{payloadJson}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE report_archive_outbox SET status = #{status}, attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE outbox_id = #{outboxId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM report_archive_outbox WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, outbox_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM report_archive_outbox WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') ORDER BY created_at ASC, outbox_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
